subject: The secret 87% of users discovered yesterday
preview_text: This morning, 2,143 Predictify users cashed in on something you haven't seen yet. Don't fall behind.
body_paragraphs: While you were sleeping, 2,143 other punters just got a head start you won't believe. They all did one simple thing in the app at 6 AM. And by post time, the results were staggering.

They checked the 'Confidence Spike' alert. It's our AI flagging horses where the data shifted dramatically overnight—new jockey stats, track conditions, late scratches. Today, it highlighted a 20/1 shot at Cheltenham. The 2,143 users who saw it? They're celebrating a payout the rest of the crowd missed completely. That's the difference between guessing and knowing.

This isn't luck. It's the 'Daily Edge' notification in your app. It's free. It takes 10 seconds. And it's how the sharpest punters separate themselves from the weekend crowd who rely on yesterday's newspaper tips.

Open the app right now. Tap the bell icon for notifications. Turn on 'Daily Edge'. Tomorrow's alerts drop at 6 AM. Don't be the one checking the results after the race. P.S. The AI is currently calculating a massive data shift for a horse in tomorrow's 3:30 at Ascot. The users who are ready will see it first.
